Alex / Laura / Mina —

I reviewed SyncCore_Redlines_v1.docx and summarized our position below. I attached our tracked-change reply (Redlines_LR1.docx). High level: we can accomodate some of the shifts but there are a few items that require compromise.

Redline highlights (our position):
- Term (24 months): Acceptable. We prefer a clause that allows for a single mid-term pricing review tied to published rate cards; we will not automatically reprice mid-term absent material usage deviation.
- Indemnity: We cannot accept the broad carve that removes Redwood's ability to defend IP claims. We will agree to limit customer indemnity to direct third-party IP infringement claims tied to customer's use of the service. We propose specific language in Redlines_LR1.docx.
- SLA credits: We can cap SLA credits at the lesser of 6 months' worth of fees or an amount equal to 100% of monthly committed spend for a single incident cohort; SyncCore's proposed unlimited credit/fee waiver is not acceptable.
- Data handling / retention: We will add audit log evidence and KMS controls in the order form but cannot alter core retention defaults in the MSA without additional compliance review (30-day lead).

Next steps:
1) Mina to send a draft order-form appendix with the proposed uplift pricing and overage ladder.
2) Alex — if you accept the indemnity narrowing (third-party IP only) and the SLA credit cap above, we can move to an internal signoff route and produce a DocuSign-ready packet.

Attachment: Redlines_LR1.docx (Redwood tracked changes)

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Licensing
Redwood Inference
